## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

ExerciseSessionManager — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/session/ExerciseSessionManager.kt

## Trigger

A Health Services sensor-data callback, delivered while the exercise
session is open — nothing observes it. The class's own documentation
states it explicitly: "This manager does not observe sensor readings;
a missing one from an available data type has no path back to open or
close, so it can neither close nor fail the session." No
`MeasureClient`, no `MeasureCallback`, and no `ExerciseUpdateCallback`
is registered anywhere in `:app-wear`.

## Today

`ExerciseSessionManager` opens the exercise session
(`ExerciseSessionSystem.startExerciseSession`) at preparation and
closes it at race end, and exposes `isDataTypeAvailable` and
`onInteractivityChanged` (batching mode) — nothing else. It is
injected into `RaceLaunchController`, `StopRaceController` and
`EndOfRaceViewModel` for lifecycle only. `MainRacePageViewModel`
declares `onHeartRateReading(bpm, atElapsedRealtime)`,
`onDistanceSample(cumulativeDistanceM, speedMetersPerSecond,
atElapsedRealtime)` and `onTick(nowElapsedRealtime)`;
`PreparationViewModel` declares `onHeartRateReading(bpm,
atElapsedRealtime)`. None of the four has a caller anywhere in
`src/main` of `:app-wear` — confirmed by a symbol search across the
module. `MainActivity`'s `WatchApp` composable builds
`MainRacePageViewModel` and `PreparationViewModel` through
`hiltViewModel(...) { factory -> factory.create(...) }` and never
calls any of these methods afterwards. `MainRacePageScreen` and
`PreparationScreen` only read `viewModel.uiState`; they call no method
on the view model. `ExerciseSessionSystemImpl` wraps `ExerciseClient`
for `startExerciseAsync`/`endExerciseAsync`/
`getCapabilitiesAsync`/`overrideBatchingModesForActiveExerciseAsync`
only — no update callback is registered on it either. No periodic
timer (`Handler.postDelayed`, a ticker `Flow`, or equivalent) exists
anywhere in `:app-wear`'s `src/main` to drive `onTick`.

## Expected

Once the exercise session is open, something registers for the
`SensorDataType`s `ExerciseSessionManager.isDataTypeAvailable`
reports as available on this device (heart rate, distance, speed) and
receives their readings for as long as the session runs. While the
preparation screen is the one shown, each heart-rate reading is
forwarded to `PreparationViewModel.onHeartRateReading`. While the main
race page is the one shown, each heart-rate reading is forwarded to
`MainRacePageViewModel.onHeartRateReading`, and each distance/speed
sample is forwarded to `MainRacePageViewModel.onDistanceSample`. A
periodic clock tick, independent of any sensor delivery, is forwarded
to `MainRacePageViewModel.onTick` for as long as that page is shown,
so the segment-elapsed and freshness-fallback blocks keep refreshing
between sensor readings — this periodic tick has no existing mechanism
anywhere in `:app-wear` to reuse and is itself a second gap the fix
must supply. Because `MainRacePageViewModel` and `PreparationViewModel`
are scoped per-screen through `hiltViewModel`, whatever registers the
callback must itself be reachable from wherever the screen is
composed (`MainActivity`'s `WatchApp`, `MainRacePageScreen` or
`PreparationScreen`) — `ExerciseSessionManager` today is reachable only
from `RaceLaunchController`, `StopRaceController` and
`EndOfRaceViewModel`, none of which sit on that path, so exposing a
readings stream from it that the screen layer can collect is itself
part of what the fix must add.
